learned: Likes contemplative art in landscape and strong architecture (Murou Art Forest, D.T. Suzuki Museum, Ando), and large outdoor art in public space (liked Tokyo Atlas).
Food must be safe for gluten, dairy, oats and eggs. Liked relaxed vegan, gluten-free cafés with seasonal menus (Buddha, FOLK in Osaka).
Idea-driven science fiction (Ted Chiang, Arrival), spiritual travel stories (Shantaram) and body-mind psychology.
Only report news: don't repeat that an artist has no tour dates; stay silent until something changes.
